decisions.reason: As an organic sliced salami product it is very close to the firm's established meat-processing and bio assortment, and its continued website presence from 2023 to 2024 suggests the firm has learned enough from early market feedback to keep refining rather than withdrawing it.

The premium salami-sharing snack fits the firm's core salami capabilities, but its reduced prominence on the website in 2024 indicates only moderate traction, so management would likely keep it for now while using accumulated category knowledge to improve positioning.

Organic boiled pork sausage is highly related to the firm's existing sausage know-how and the 2024 dedicated page signals an active launch phase, so a German food producer with strong absorptive capacity would usually allow more time to learn before dropping it.

Thinly sliced organic chicken breast is adjacent to the firm's cold-cut and organic competences, and although poultry adds some complexity, the product is close enough to existing knowledge that management would likely retain it and adjust the offer based on first-year results.

An organic herb-coated salami is an incremental extension of the firm's core salami expertise, making it easy to assimilate customer feedback and improve commercially, so the most likely decision is to continue it.
